name: Neptune
//: Auth state (claude / az / gh) is mounted as SHARED named volumes in docker-compose.yml so one `make auth` + `claude` login seeds every worktree on this host and survives rebuilds.
//ports: docker-compose `ports:` is the single source of truth. We deliberately do NOT set forwardPorts/portsAttributes — with per-worktree port slots, VS Code's speculative 127.0.0.1:<port> pre-bind on every window steals traffic from the container that actually owns the port. `otherPortsAttributes: ignore` skips auto-forward; Docker still publishes via compose.
